cols.text: Each row shows layout B1 in one style, light then dark. Left to right: the light panel, the light pop-out window, the dark panel on the Library tab after Copy, and the dark window. Layout and words are the same in every row.

cap0.text:
S1 – Textbook
Paper and print: serif labels, one oxblood accent, and the equation between two printed rules. Dark is the same page by lamplight.

cap1.text:
S2 – Board
A classroom board. Light is a whiteboard with green marker. Dark is a blackboard with chalk yellow.

cap2.text:
S3 – Graph paper
Squared paper under the equation and keys ruled as one grid. Light is blue ink on paper. Dark is a blueprint.

cap3.text:
S4 – Calculator
A scientific calculator: a pale display, raised keys and one orange main key. Light and dark are two case colours.

cap4.text:
S5 – Wayfinding
Public signage: thick lines, a blue header, and yellow for what is selected or done. Dark swaps to white lines on black.

cap5.text:
S6 – Radical
The icon made into the panel: navy, sky blue, and the equation under a drawn radical sign. Dark keeps the navy and dims the page.

capR.text:
S6 – Radical, refined
Light has no dark block: the radical sign and its bar are the only strong colour. Left to right: light panel, light Library tab after Copy, light window, then the same three in dark. The window is one column: the field takes the full width and stays short, and the symbols use the width with 14 keys a row.

capRest.text: S6 – Radical, other screens\nLeft to right: an empty field with the skip link focused, Draw, saving a formula, Shortcuts, text styles as a symbol category, and Settings.
